description: FlexMeasures is an energy-management backend created and maintained by Seita Energy Flexibility BV in the Netherlands. It converts asset data and forecasts into schedules for batteries, heat pumps and flexible industrial processes. API and command-line interfaces ingest time series; plugins connect data services and protocols, while a user interface displays assets and results. Coverage is global and configured for each building, factory or customer portfolio. Time resolution, forecast horizon and uncertainty information are represented through the timely-beliefs dependency. Public software and documentation are free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that useful schedules require correctly configured asset constraints and data services; the repository does not establish realised savings for every installation. Integrations can also require separate provider accounts. FlexMeasures supports demand-response and operational scenario studies, complementary to system-level capacity planning in PyPSA (model-pypsa). The reviewed resource is the backend software, including its documented extension points. No service was deployed, private data uploaded or physical asset controlled.
